description: Connects a name (with and without www) to a website built and hosted with DFYWeb, and lets the website send email from that name (DKIM, return path and DMARC links). Applied with a host for a subdomain; at Cloudflare, which flattens a CNAME at the apex, also without a host for the bare domain.
variableDescription: linktoken: the 12-character code DFYWeb gives this website. The email records point at its names on dfywebmail.com, where DFYWeb publishes the sending records (DKIM, return path, SPF) and DMARC.
